codes.meaning: Provider invocation completed and all required outputs were finalized successfully.
Provider returned a declared semantic capability error.
Provider process/component/runtime failed outside the semantic error contract.
Provider could not be launched under the requested Execution Binding/profile.
Execution Binding is incomplete, stale, inconsistent, or invalid for launch.
Launched/calling provider identity does not match the binding.
Required point-of-use authority grant is absent, expired, revoked, or mismatched.
Bound input content/revision no longer matches the expected binding.
Provider attempted to write to a missing/unbound/invalid output allocation.
Provider returned malformed or contract-incompatible output metadata/result.
Trusted Artifact Store could not validate/finalize staged provider output.
Invocation exceeded its configured deadline/resource time budget.
Invocation was cancelled by Task/runtime control.
Authority was revoked during execution; subsequent protected access is blocked.
Invocation exceeded a memory/output/CPU or other deterministic resource limit.
Provider violated or could not complete the typed invocation protocol.
Untrusted provider diagnostic output exceeded configured bounds.
Runtime cannot prove the externally observable outcome and must reconcile before retry.
